name: Unidentified species
description: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their red skin and thin, elongated heads with large bluish-gray eyes situated on the sides. In 4 ABY, at least four members of this species could be found in the city Wrils on the planet Svivren, while at least three others disembarked from a transport known as the Tippler's Groan onto the planet Phorliss shortly thereafter.
